messages:
devops-alert-bot: autopager fired — service=embedder-canary env=prod-canary release=2026.3.1 metric=error_rate p95 error_rate=6.3% threshold=5% -> PagerDuty: P1

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-4521 triggered, page sent to rotation 'sre-oncall'. @maya notified.

maya: acked. I'm paged oncall, taking lead. what's the customer impact?

samir: seeing OOMs on canary hosts in cluster-quant-3, kernel logs showing 'Killed process', mem usage >90%. also a spike in retransmits on the same nodes.

leo: correlating with new quant-kernel build in this release — telemetry shows kv-cache invalidation thrash starting t+2m after rollout. p95 latency and retries line up.

maya: OK — I'm going to ramp the canary down to 0% and start a rollback. samir/leo, prep rollback commands + smoke checks. also suppress autopager to avoid noisy repeats.

samir: rollback command queued:```sh
redwood deploy rollback --release canary-2026.3.1 --target canary:0.0 --wait
```

oncall-bot: rollback started by maya at 1807654372. Expected completion ~3m. Autopager suppression enabled for 10m.

ana: support notified, creating CS alert (CS-1892). no customer tickets reported yet, but routing to on-call CS.

leo: as a mitigation I'll pin quant kernel to v1.2 on affected canary nodes and disable the new batching opt; then run canary smoke with smaller batch sizes.

maya: rollback completed on all canary hosts; healthchecks OK (3/3). metrics: error_rate falling back under 1% and latency p95 trending down. leaving monitoring on.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4521 acknowledged by maya. Escalation canceled.

support-bot: CS updated: 'Canary release rollback performed, low customer impact observed, monitoring in place.'

maya: postmortem ticket created: INT-2026-4521. assigning to eng-ml for root cause and follow-up. I'll close this thread after 30m of clean telemetry. :white_check_mark:
